== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ストームトルーパー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">能力値＞２の帝国軍がいる位置にはコストなしで配備できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">皇帝に完全な忠誠を誓う精鋭突撃部隊の名も無き一員。命令には無条件で従い、任務のために命を投げ出すことを厭わない。最前線の速攻部隊。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Stormtrooper]].

'''Lore''' — A nameless member of the elite shock troops totally loyal to the Emperor. Obeys orders without condition and does not begrudge giving his life for the mission. A front-line rapid-assault unit.

'''Game text''' — May deploy free to a location where an Imperial with ability > 2 is present.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore names a nameless member and a front-line rapid-assault unit. Game text omits “Deploys only as a non-unique Imperial.” White border. CategoryOneGames Premiere 2PG Japanese catalog; the photograph crops the copyright year.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-stormtrooper.gif|Original English face]], [[Stormtrooper]].</ref>
